newsitem.title: USA: Trans-Lux Corp buys scoreboard sign segment.
newsitem.headline: Trans-Lux Corp buys scoreboard sign segment.

text.p: Trans-Lux Corp said on Thursday that its subsidiary had aquired the catalog and custom scoreboard sign business segment of Fairtron Corp, to enable it to reach broader markets.

The company did not say how much the acquisition was worth, but reported that revenues for the latest fiscal year for the catalog scoreboard business, excluding revenues of the custom business, were about $8.5 million.

"The catalog scoreboard business primarily serves college and high school sports facilities and is a natural follow-up to the company's previous acquisitions," said Trans-Lux chief executive Victor Liss.
Trans-Lux manufactures and services real-time electronic information displays.
